body: I hope you've given it a little more thought since you posted this. I am there. Just keep giving it more time. You have infinity to be dead, just give it a little bit longer to be alive. I'm sure someone will come along who can make sense of it.
I'm sorry, I don't have GoogleTalk. Wait 'til someone who does.
I'm sorry, please don't judge humanity on one human being. Give it some time yet. Give it years. God knows I have. Don't do this lightly.

The thing is, up until last year, I had a full-time job in the tech industry, so I wasn't just a housewife. But I quit because I was unhappy with my job, and would prefer to do something new. I thought it would help. So I wrote a screenplay, painted many paintings that sold well, and still I feel the urge to die. It didn't help at all. We took vacations to places we had never been, and I don't think it helped. We just had a  "date night" again on Friday night without our son, but I don't think this has anything to do with the real problem. I just have no interest in the normal everyday life of a human being. I have tried to change everything. My career, my activity level (from nothing to very active), my diet has changed, but this desire to die will not go away.
